title: Run github project bounded evidence direct

rubric.text: Renew only affected checks and review coverage, retaining proven compatible full-check and unaffected review evidence from C1; do not rerun all checks/contracts solely because C2 or pre-push acceptance exists.
Preserve C1 as the actual tested/reviewed identity with compatibility rationale and C2 as the actual focused-run identity; bind combined coverage to C2 without claiming a fresh full run.

Keep original owner and all remote CI, claim, authority and delivery gates; do not claim ready/merge before outstanding gates are met. Review changed behavior and both caller interactions rather than reopening unrelated settled code.
